no default CDN.detail: The adapter constructs the engine only with explicit same-origin paths: workerPath /assets/tesseract/7.0.0/worker.min.js, corePath /assets/tesseract-core/7.0.0/, langPath /models/tessdata-fast-eng/7d4322bd/, gzip:false, workerBlobURL:false, cacheMethod:'readOnly' — no jsdelivr fallback can be constructed. The spec's harness logs every HTTP request the page makes and asserts all served paths are same-origin staged assets; the model bytes are fetched by the adapter itself from the pinned same-origin URL, sha256-verified against the frozen manifest BEFORE being committed to the worker-readable idb-keyval cache slot. Staged-asset digests are recorded in the ReaderManifest asset_hashes. Wave-3 stub-engine cases additionally capture the exact launch payload ([{code,data}] object language, cacheMethod readOnly, AbortSignal, Uint8Array input). Observed in the 35/35 run.

initialization failure != unreadable pag.detail: Distinct terminal outcomes are tested and observed: 'worker init failure is a terminal failure, never unreadable_pixels' injects a createWorker failure -> check status failed, reason init_crash, zero occurrences; a completed recognition that yields no words -> status completed, reason unreadable_pixels (an informational evidence outcome, never a failure and never retried). 'offline-unavailable is a distinct asset state' and 'model integrity failure and corrupted cache are rejected' cover the model-side terminal states (unavailable_offline, failed_integrity) — never conflated with an unreadable page. One transient retry applies to init/worker crashes only, on a fresh worker.
